1.title: S.U.V. Driver Charged With Murder in Los Angeles Bus Crash
1.summary: Prosecutors said the driver was impaired by drugs and ran a red light before ramming a city bus on Tuesday. Two people died. Compounding the tragedy, a news helicopter also crashed.

2.title: US fans with Ed Sheeran tickets are left 'torn' by Macklemore controversy
2.summary: With Sheeran's next gig due this weekend, some fans said they were in two minds about the show.

3.title: Alabama Executes Inmate After Supreme Court Blocked Last Attempt
3.summary: Jeffery Lee had raised concerns about use of nitrogen gas and the legacy of an abandoned practice that allowed judges to override juries on death sentences.

4.title: Yemen War Intensifies as Houthi Militia Advances on Marib
4.summary: Clashes between Iranian-backed Houthi fighters and Saudi-backed government forces have been reported near oil-rich Marib Province.

5.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
5.summary: The BBC understands Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi are among the delegates allowed to enter the US.

6.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
6.summary: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.
